_comment: Optional metadata for the content build. EVERY field here is optional: a new file dropped into notes/ or pdfs/ is published by `npm run build` without touching this file — title, description, headings, word count and size are read from the file itself, and the category comes from the first matching entry in `rules` (or `defaults.category`). Use `notes`/`resources` only to override what the file cannot tell us: category, tags, description, title. Keys are exact filenames.
